label: DAY 22
title: AI bots play my bidding game. The champion lost to a bot that skips 6 of 9 cards.

lines.text: Wait. Your best bot lost to that one?
That one ignores six of the nine cards. And it still won.

scenes.title: My game: Coin Bid
lines: Two bots, a hundred coins each. Nine cards, worth one to nine points.
Secret bids. The higher bid pays and takes the points.

scenes.title: 6 AI bots
lines: Six bots. Value bids more on bigger cards.
Big Three only bids on the seven, eight and nine.
Mirror copies its rival's last bid, plus one.

scenes.title: Win rate, 5,000 games each
lines: Fifteen thousand games. Value won eighty seven and a half percent.

scenes.title: Value vs Big Three, 1,000 games
lines: Not quite. Head to head, Big Three won five eighty nine to four eleven.

scenes.label: Value's average spend on cards 1 to 6
scenes.sub: coins. Big Three bid 0 on them.
lines: It paid eighty one coins, on average, for the small cards.
Big Three bid zero on those. One coin would have won them.

scenes.title: Why it ran short
log: cards 1 to 6 add up to 21 points
23 wins, so value needs one big card
lines: The small cards only add up to twenty one. You need twenty three.
On big cards, Value bid about twenty five. Big Three bid thirty three.

scenes.title: Mirror vs Big Three

lines.text: So Big Three can't be beaten?

lines: Mirror beats it. Five forty nine to four forty three.
Every big card Mirror took, it won by exactly one coin.

scenes.title: Who beats who, 1,000 games
lines: And Value crushes Mirror, nine seventy eight to fourteen.
Exactly. A circle. Every bot loses to someone.

scenes.title: The fix: Counter
log: $ counter: bids like value, max rival top bid + 1

lines.text: So build one bot that beats them all.

lines: I tried. Counter beat Big Three seven seventy two to two twenty eight.
Then Value beat Counter, eight sixty one to ninety three.

scenes.sub: What bot would break the circle?
lines: What bot would you add to break the circle? Tell me in the comments.

thumbnail.headline: My best bot LOST to the lazy one
